source: The nine orders of EXP-019: every debate that stores its packet, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-05. `recommendation` is the analyst's recorded payload, read from the live graph on 2026-10-07. `score_arithmetic` is what the analyst records from sprint 255 on. `arithmetic_lines` is the text EXP-019's arm B appended to the packet, frozen at its pre-registration.

rationale.summary: TGT cleared the neutral confidence gate on its composite technical score (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, SMA-200 distance, and EMA crossover). and a fundamental score of 0.512 and a news-sentiment score of 0.494

orders.arithmetic_lines:
Score arithmetic, the rule for every order (definitions from the analyst's code, the same for every reviewer): inside quant_metrics each key ending in _score, and each fundamental sub-score, is a 0-100 band score in which 50 is neutral; technical_score = 0.80 x (mean of the technical sub-scores / 100) + 0.20 x (rs_score / 100); fundamental_score = (mean of the fundamental sub-scores) / 100; composite_score = 0.50 x technical_score + 0.30 x fundamental_score + 0.20 x sentiment_score, divided by the sum of the weights of the pillars that are present; confidence = 0.30 + 0.60 x composite_score; a pillar score of 0.50 is neutral; an order is recommended only if confidence >= base_min_confidence_score.
Score arithmetic for TGT: technical sub-scores (14): mean 55.36; rs_score=40; technical_score=0.5229; fundamental sub-scores (8): pe=60, roe=80, net_margin=30, current_ratio=25, pb=40, debt_equity=65, eps_growth=65, revenue_growth=45; fundamental_score=0.5125; sentiment_score=0.4944; contributions to composite_score: technical 0.2614, fundamental 0.1537, sentiment 0.0989; composite_score=0.5141; confidence=0.6084; base_min_confidence_score=0.600; margin over the floor=+0.0084.
Regime, the rule for every order: vix_index only selects the regime label (risk_on at or below 15, risk_off from 20, high_volatility from 25, extreme_volatility from 35, neutral otherwise). The label is printed and changes no number: base_min_confidence_score, base_stop_loss_pct, base_take_profit_pct and base_max_holding_days are the same constants under every label, and the VIX is not an input to any score.
